display.title: Episode 457: The Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts, Chapter 4 (Chanukah)
display.summary_short: A Chanukah show: mitzvah charts, a sing-along of Chanukah songs in Hebrew, English and Yiddish, Shema with three brothers, and the final chapter of the Ten Wedding Gifts.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi opens the Chanukah show by asking Tzivos Hashem soldiers to fill in the Chanukah mitzvah charts and mission cards from the newsletter, with bonus points for inviting someone without a menorah to their candle-lighting. A studio guest leads a Chanukah sing-along: Maoz Tzur, 'I Have a Little Dreidel', 'Chanukah, Chanukah' in Hebrew, and an old Yiddish song for Zeidy and Bubby to remember. Three brothers recite the Shema with their proud parents, their mother adds a few words, and everyone gives tzedakah. In the final chapter of 'The Baal Shem Tov and the Ten Wedding Gifts', Avraham and Sarah bring the lost boy home to his father, the poritz, who insists on rewarding them despite Avraham's protest that he only did what the Torah teaches. At a grand banquet the poritz gives them the park, another poritz the lumberyard, and so on, until all ten gifts promised by the Baal Shem Tov's students come true. The show ends with an invitation to the giant Dreidel House in Manhattan and Shabbos candle-lighting after the menorah.
display.lesson: Hashem sees every kind deed and rewards it in full measure, often in ways we could never imagine.
